text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The MCAG is a 
static restricted earth fault relay available single and triple pole 
manufactured by GEC ALSTHOM. This relay is used for protected the power 
transformers and generators. This is a current operated having seven equally 
spaced setting. The setting ranges are given below:
0.025 
0.1 A
0.05 
0.2 A
0.1 
0.4 A
0.2 
0.8 A
0.25 
1.0 A
0.5 
2.0 A
1.0 
4.0 A
The relay may be used for any type of high
impedance
circulating current protection
When used as a high impedance relay a stabilizing resistor must be connected in
series with the current circuit
The first draft initiated by eng
Qrashy Ghareeb from WDL, The document tested at Sep. 2001 at
El EZZ 220kv substation, by eng. Mohamed Helmy El Qady
and approved at 22 May. 2002
Safety Precautions
Make CT secondary circuits are shorted
 before isolating the
 relay for test
Switch on the MCB for DC supply
The equipment under test must be out of service
Tools and Equipment
Secondary injection test
Multi finger test plug type MMLB 01 for use with block
 type MMLG is fitted
Miniature split plug type MMLB 03 to fit relay plug bridge
Three calibrated multi
 meters 0-10A ac, 0-400 V ac
Works to be Carried Out
Terminals of the relay are normally as below, but reference should always be
made to the relevant diagram
Relay type | AC current input | Normally
 open contacts
Single pole | 27-28 | 1,3 and 2,4
Triple pole | R 
 23,24 | 1,3 and 2,4
Triple pole | S 
 25,26 | 1,3 and 2,4
Triple pole | T 
 27,28 | 1,3 and 2,4
The contacts are normally connected in parallel for the three phases but
aversion of the relay having contacts brought out separately is available
Commissioning test
If the relay is wired through an MMLG test block it is recommended that
 all secondary injection tests should be carried out using this block.
Ensure that the main system current transformer are shorted before isolating the relay from the current transformer in preparation for
 secondary injection test.
When type MMLG test block facilities are installed it is important that
 the sockets in the type MMLB 01 test plug, which correspond to the current
 transformer secondary winding, are linked before the test plug is inserted
 into the test block. Similarly, a MMLB 02 single finger test plug must be
 terminated with an ammeter before it is inserted to monitor CT secondary
 currents.
Relay CT shorting switches
With the relay removed from its case, check electrically that the
CT shorting
switch is closed
Secondary injection testing
Connect the circuit as shown in figure
 (1) and ensure that the current
 transformer primary is open circuit and that if any earthing connection are
 fitted
Increase the current until the relay just operates
Record the operating current of the relay which measured by ammeter A2
Record the total current which measured by ammeter A1
This test should be repeated for each pole of the relay
